function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_post_api_token
function.description: Create a new API token for authenticating against the API endpoints. The token ensures secure access to the provided services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to your API tokens.  
If you’re looking to view or manage the token tied to **098‑293**, please log into your account’s developer portal or run the following command from your terminal:

```bash
curl -X GET https://api.yourservice.com/v1/api-tokens \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
```

Replace `YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN` with a bearer token that has permission to read API tokens. This will return a JSON array containing all active tokens for the specified user (`098‑293`).  

Alternatively, if you’d prefer to generate a brand‑new token, let me know and I’ll walk you through creating one securely.
